title: Independent semantic check of root-repaired introduction candidates
scope: Read-only backcheck of all 60 remaining VE/TS proposals. One VE photograph imperative is excluded pending a defensible verb. No repository edits.
method: Compared each candidate to its exact current paired English body, current target status, and canonical English narration. Reviewed repaired meaning, conditions, numbers, scope, causality and direction. This is not fluent-speaker approval.

languageFormChecks.note: Potential Tshivenda agreement question: these phrases now use English “land” where the earlier noun mavu carried a/a-class agreement. I cannot determine the borrowed noun’s concord confidently in this text-only review. The intended source meaning remains clear; this is a fluent-form check, not a semantic hold.

focusedChecks.VE_slide1_distance: vhukale vhu ngafhani preserves how far/how much distance the learner walks each day; daily frequency remains explicit.
focusedChecks.VE_slide22_walkout: Ibani conveys go/walk out; the exact English remainder retains checking the sketch against the ground.
focusedChecks.VE_slide11_own_farm: The source qualifier “your own farm” remains attached to the comparison; bulasi yaṋu explicitly keeps the learner’s farm as the site. No broader site is introduced.
focusedChecks.VE_slide15_numbers_and_contrast: 0 and 5 remain unchanged, and the draft retains the contrast between walking/effort and fences. It does not replace fences with trees or another boundary feature.
focusedChecks.VE_slide20_inward_arrows: The arrows are drawn inward from outside; sun, wind, fire and water are all retained in the exact English list.
focusedChecks.VE_slide21_numbers_order_direction: Zone 0 and Zone 1 remain the first marks; then the learner works outward to the extent of the land. No numbers or direction changed.
focusedChecks.TS_slide20_inward_arrows: The arrows enter from outside, and all four factors remain in the source order.
focusedChecks.TS_slide21_numbers_order_direction: Zone 0 and Zone 1 remain first, followed by outward work to the land extent.
focusedChecks.root_excluded_VE_slide21_photograph: The unestablished photograph imperative is excluded from the 60 candidates and left as exact source English; this avoids publishing an uncertain verb.
focusedChecks.VE_borrowed_land_concord: Two Tshivenda phrases retain agreement that formerly matched mavu after the noun was changed to English land. The intended meaning remains clear, but a fluent speaker should confirm natural concord.
